capabilities: define custom regex patterns in settings
automatically insert links when a pattern matches
map regex capture groups into replacement URLs
trigger replacements on space or enter while editing
extras: Tab-key support is not yet implemented; the README says it will be added in future updates. Issues and suggestions are handled via GitHub.
problem: Obsidian requires manually creating links or switching between editing and reading modes, so repetitive text like issue keys stays unlinked while writing.
summary: Regex-based link automation plugin that automatically inserts configured links when matched text patterns are typed.
